title: Decentralised Identifier-Anchored Verifiable Credentials with On-Chain Revocation for Social Media Identity Management
description: Reference implementation of an Ethereum registry of DID documents with per-credential revocation keyed by the issuer DID (Solidity), a Node.js service that issues W3C Verifiable Credentials with eddsa-jcs-2022 proofs (Ed25519, Multikey), a verifier that checks a credential against the registry with all reads pinned to one block, and the scripts and raw logs behind the measurements. Version 1.1.0: a pause no longer blocks revocation or deactivation; revocations carry an RFC 5280 reason code; administrator actions emit events; a controller handover needs the new address's acceptance; the registry stores no copies, which lowers the gas of revocation and DID creation; validFrom is checked; proofs follow eddsa-jcs-2022 section 3.3 and reproduce the W3C test vector; gas is reported for the osaka schedule and for the schedule Sepolia has used since 6 October 2026; 164 tests.
